mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the uprights with the crossbar was satisfying: the separate posts became a recognizable rectangular frame, with a clear instruction and physical change.

leastWorthwhile.text: The two flips were less distinctive in text because the changes of view were subtle. I cannot judge how clear they would be in the artwork.

surprise.text: Connecting the lead produced a hand-and-pinwheel animation rather than an obvious depiction of the connection.

arbitrary.text: The final lead’s purpose was not apparent from the resulting description, although the goal clearly specified the action.

continue.text: I would be curious to see what the window does next, but the largely directed fittings and subtle view changes make that a modest interest rather than a strong desire to continue.
